Class OrderEvent<Order extends ISimpleOrder>

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
de.eldoria.companies.events.order.OrderEvent<Order>
Type Parameters:
Order - type of order
All Implemented Interfaces:
OrderProvider<Order>, OwnerProvider
Direct Known Subclasses:
OrderAcceptEvent, OrderCanceledEvent, OrderCreatedEvent, OrderDeliveryEvent, OrderDoneEvent, OrderExpiredEvent, OrderPaymentEvent, OrderReceivedEvent, OrderRemovedEvent, PreOrderAcceptEvent
public abstract class OrderEvent<Order extends ISimpleOrder> extends org.bukkit.event.Event implements OrderProvider<Order>, OwnerProvider
Base of the events about an existing order. Listen to its subclasses; this class has no handler list.

Events carry both sides of an order. Companies keeps orders anonymous: never show the owner to the company's members or the company to the owner. Use both sides only for logic, logging or staff tools.

Order events fire only on the server where the action happened. Expiry and removal of unclaimed orders happen on the primary server of a network.
